canonical_object.name: Typed Partial Relational Composition Operator
canonical_object.role: Composes typed lawful process operands under a declared context without licensing identity collapse.

definition.statement: X otimes_Y Z is defined only when operand types, composition context Y, distinction preservation, admissibility non-emptiness, and closure-class compatibility are all declared and satisfied.
definition.undefined_condition: If a required typing, context, distinction, admissibility, or closure-class condition is absent or fails, the composition is undefined rather than an unrestricted false statement.

lawfulness_conditions: D(X|Z) remains above the declared distinction floor unless a collapse-boundary event is explicitly declared.
The result remains inside a declared RT, aRT, or typed_closure_candidate class.

projection_window_specialization.name: otimes_intersection
projection_window_specialization.form: Pi_A otimes_intersection Pi_B := Pi_(A intersection B)
projection_window_specialization.associativity_basis: Associativity follows from set intersection within the declared admissibility-window context.
projection_window_specialization.non_generalization: This subcase does not prove global associativity, commutativity, or identity preservation for arbitrary X otimes_Y Z.

negative_constraints: Not a standard tensor product by default.
Not scalar multiplication or scalar product.
Does not imply X = X otimes_Y Z.
Does not imply Z = X otimes_Y Z.
Does not promote topology, geometry, physics-app, or empirical claims.
failure_conditions: FAIL_OTIMES_001: missing or invalid operand typing
FAIL_OTIMES_003: distinction collapse below the declared floor
FAIL_OTIMES_007: projection equivalence mistaken for process identity
FAIL_OTIMES_008: unproven commutativity or associativity assumed
open_limits: General multi-step otimes composition still requires parent-family hardening.
Context-specific associativity must be proved or validated per context family.
Residue-admissibility interference semantics for directional coupling remain a separate proof obligation.
